text.jp:
あ、いや、昔読んだことがある気がしてな。
それより見てくれ。
何か書き込まれてるんだ。
text.official_en: It’s a book I think I read before, but never mind that—someone’s scribbled something in the corner.
text.real_en: Oh, no, I think I read it once long ago. But look at this. Someone's written something in it.

text.jp:
ああ、スパイとして城に
しばらく潜入してもらってたんだ。
text.official_en: Yeah, he’s one of my mine. Had him join the military as a mole a while back.
text.real_en: Yeah. I had him infiltrate the castle as a spy for a while.

text.jp:
ありがとう。
必ず、国の未来を切り開いてみせます。
text.official_en: Thank you. I promise you: I will lead Zoldaad toward a brighter future—whatever it takes.
text.real_en: Thank you. I promise we'll forge a future for this country.

text.jp: ありがとな。
text.official_en: Appreciate it.

text.jp:
え、どういうことだ？
知り合いなのか？
text.official_en: What’s going on? You know him, Jake?
text.real_en: Wait, what do you mean? You know him?

text.jp:
おいおい、お前か。
おどかすんじゃねーよ。
text.official_en: Oh, it’s you. Scared the hell outta me.

text.jp:
お願いです。
鍵を渡してください。
text.official_en: Please. Hand over the key.

text.jp: こいつ面倒だな、さっさと倒しちまおうぜ。
text.official_en: How ’bout a little less conversation and a little more action, huh? Let’s just beat the key outta him.
text.real_en: What a pain. Let's just beat him already.

text.jp: この本……。
text.official_en: Huh, would you look at that...
text.real_en: This book...

text.jp:
これ……なんだろうな。
なにかの暗号か？
text.official_en: Wonder what it is? Some kind of code or a riddle?

text.jp:
これ、もしよかったらどうぞ！
城内で見つけたんです、お役立てください。
text.official_en: Perfect timing, sir! I found something that might help you out. Here.
text.real_en: Here, take this if you'd like! I found it inside the castle. I hope it helps.

text.jp: しかし……私には皇帝より受けた任が……。
text.official_en: Your Highness...but I’ve...explicit orders from Emperor Sohze and...
text.real_en: But... I have a duty the emperor entrusted to me...

text.jp: すみません！　完全になりきってました。
text.official_en: Sorry, sir. Got a little too committed to the act.
text.real_en: Sorry! I got completely caught up in my role.

text.jp: そう来なくっちゃなぁ！
text.official_en: Now that’s what I’m talkin’ about!

text.jp: どうかしたのか？
text.official_en: What is it?

text.jp:
なんだ、貴様ら！
怪しいものは始末する！
text.official_en: Who the...!? Not sure how you all got in, but you’re sure as hell not getting out alive!
text.real_en: Who are you!? I'll dispose of anyone suspicious!

text.jp: よし、開いたぞ！
text.official_en: There, opened!

text.jp:
シエラ様！？
捕らえられたはずでは……。
text.official_en: Your Highness!? I thought you were in the dungeon. How did you...
text.real_en: Shera-sama!? I thought you had been captured...

text.jp:
ゾルダードの未来のため、
玉座へ行く必要があるのです。
text.official_en: Captain—for the future of Zoldaad, we must get to the throne room.
text.real_en: For Zoldaad's future, we have to reach the throne.

text.jp: 今のゾルダードにうんざりしているんじゃないか？
text.official_en: Captain, aren’t you fed up with the way Zoldaad is right now?
text.real_en: Aren't you fed up with Zoldaad the way it is now?

text.jp: 今のゾルダードにうんざりしているんじゃないか？
text.official_en: Captain, aren’t you fed up with the way Zoldaad is right now?
text.real_en: Aren't you fed up with Zoldaad the way it is now?

text.jp: 作戦成功を祈っています！
text.official_en: Be careful out there, and good luck on your mission.
text.real_en: I hope your operation succeeds!

text.jp: 力ずくだ！
text.official_en: Ignis is right. We’ve got no time for this!
text.real_en: We'll use force!

text.jp: 準備ができたら玉座へ向かいましょう。
text.official_en: Let us enter the throne room when we are ready.

text.jp: 玉座はこの先っぽいけど、開かないな……。
text.official_en: It looks like the throne room’s just up ahead. Locked tight, though.

text.jp:
玉座への鍵です。
シエラ様、この国を……どうか！
text.official_en: Here’s the key. I beg you, Your Highness, do what needs to be done for our country.
text.real_en: Here is the key to the throne room. Shera-sama, please... save this country!

text.jp: 私でも、変革のお手伝いができるのであれば……！
text.official_en: If a mook like me can help bring about the change we need...I’ll gladly help.
text.real_en: If even I can help bring about change...!

text.jp:
私は城外の兵士へ撤退命令を出してきます。
それでは、ご武運を。
text.official_en: I’ll issue the order for the troops outside the castle to retreat. Good luck, Your Highness.
text.real_en: I'll go give the soldiers outside the castle the order to retreat. Good luck.

text.jp:
筆の世界にそびえる黒き城。
その中に天使は眠る。
text.official_en: In the realm of brushstrokes looms a dark castle, within which an angel slumbers.

text.jp:
筆の世界にそびえる黒き城。
その中に天使は眠る。
text.official_en: In the realm of brushstrokes looms a dark castle, within which an angel slumbers.

text.jp:
腐敗したゾルダードを我々の手で変えてみせます。
力を……貸してくれませんか？
text.official_en: I swear to turn this nation around with my very own hands... So please—lend us yours to make that happen.
text.real_en: We'll change corrupt Zoldaad with our own hands. Will you... help us?

text.jp:
貴様ら！
こんなところで何をしている！
……って、ジェイクさん！？
text.official_en: You there! Halt! What are you—wait, Jake!?
text.real_en: You lot! What are you doing here!? Wait... Jake-san!?

text.jp:
邪魔な奴はぶっ倒すに限る！
がはははは！！
text.official_en: No problem you can’t solve by smackin’ it hard enough! HAHAHAHA!
text.real_en: The best way to deal with anyone in our way is to knock them down! Gahahaha!

text.jp:
鍵は部隊長の部屋にあると思います。
この階にありますので向かいましょう。
text.official_en: I believe the key to the throne room should be in the captain’s quarters situated on this floor. Let us head there.
